title: UX Friction Killers
facebook_comment_text: 💡 Beyond just field count, the real killer is often poorly implemented validation or forcing unnecessary data upfront. Engineering for true frictionlessness means balancing data needs with user patience via progressive profiling. It's a strategic move, not just a design tweak. What's the trickiest form element or data point you've had to fight for (or against) in your checkout flows?
